name: color-expert
title: color-expert
description: Deep color expertise: color spaces (OKLCH, CIELAB), palette and ramp generation, harmony systems, color naming, pigment and print-vs-screen behavior, and contrast verification.
why: The palette data elsewhere is lookup-only; this is the craft of making and judging color — perceptually uniform ramps, naming, and verified contrast.
adaptations: Root skill only: vendored SKILL.md, references/ and the CC-BY-4.0 LICENSE (full source attribution is recorded here and the license text is vendored, as CC-BY-4.0 requires). Repo-level docs (README, CLAUDE.md, ROADMAP, MAINTENANCE, SECURITY), the maintainer stats script, and evals/ are project infrastructure, not part of the skill.
